title: Prepare an entity’s agent run
responsibility: Checks the writable project, chosen runner, thread and approval, then records the user request before a run starts.

inputs.name: imageModel.preparation
inputs.description: The preparation services used to discover an image-capable Codex provider.

inputs.name: imageModel.request
inputs.description: The requested mode; only a Plan can require an image model.

inputs.name: imageModel.category
inputs.description: The entity category. Pages, shells and components require image orchestration for Plan.

inputs.name: prepareRun.preparation
inputs.type: {session: ProjectSessionService, providers: ProviderDiscoveryService, generator: ImageGenerator, evidence?: RecordedEvidenceService, emit: (event: RunEvent) => void}
inputs.description: Optional trusted evidence collaborator defaults to the session-bound recorded evidence service.

inputs.name: prepareRun.request
inputs.description: The entity request with thread, mode, provider, model, effort, text and optional approval.

inputs.name: prepareRun.controller
inputs.description: The cancellation controller whose signal is passed into the prepared run.

inputs.name: messageFor.context
inputs.description: The request whose entity, thread, mode, provider, model and approval anchor should be copied into a message.

inputs.name: messageFor.author
inputs.description: Whether the message is written by the user or agent.

inputs.name: messageFor.text
inputs.description: The exact text to put in the message.

inputs.name: recordRunFailure.context
inputs.description: The failed run’s request, planning/session access, revision, cancellation signal and optional failureRecorded flag.

inputs.name: recordRunFailure.error
inputs.description: The error to report; Error messages are kept up to 200 characters, with a generic message for other values.

outputs.name: imageModel
outputs.description: A promise for the default listed Codex image-orchestration model for a visual Plan; an empty string for other cases.

outputs.name: prepareRun
outputs.description: Prepares a run, validates the request and appends the user message. Visual Plans receive a lazy currentImage callback that reads the after-side capture at the original pinned commit, validates project and artifact identity, and returns null when no eligible capture exists. It does not launch a runner. Planned-only pages return null without a recorded-evidence request because they have no registered implementation.

outputs.name: messageFor
outputs.description: A message draft retaining request metadata and the approved version and first approved image hash when present; absent approval produces null anchors.

outputs.name: recordRunFailure
outputs.description: A promise completing after an agent failure message is appended, or immediately if failureRecorded is true. Change failures include failed or cancelled status and up to 600 characters of error detail.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects invalid project mutability, unavailable runner/model/effort, missing thread, invalid Change approval, absent required image capability/default model, and planning or branch failures.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Rejects if cancellation is observed after preparing the context and before appending the request.

errors.name: stale, foreign or corrupt current image evidence
errors.description: The lazy callback refuses invalid identity, capture, media or hash; cancellation propagates.
